newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $3.9 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $3.9 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week were expected to total $3.9 billion in 111 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings totalled $2.8 billion in 49 sales, with a $464 million Allegheny County Airport offering through Morgan Stanley & Co., Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 62 sales totaling $1.1 billion were scheduled. A $240 million Georgia offering on Tuesday was the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $529 million were on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.
